proof_origin.place: Paragraph (2): Retain the nine original constructions verbatim. Construct the ordinary integer and units maps by the same inverse-image adjunctions. Functor.compConstIso identifies inverse image of constant diagrams with constant inverse image. Evaluate the two tower endpoint identities at an arbitrary index: the comparison component is an identity, so each identity follows from the identity law. Transpose the units endpoint with the adjunction homEquiv; its chartwise formula is the definition of unitsDirect.
